metadataRaw.title: How to Instantly Relieve Nerve Pain in Your Lower Back and Leg
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows easy exercises to help instantly relieve nerve pain in the lower back and leg.

These exercises are especially helpful for bulging and herniated discs, the main cause of pinched nerves (that leads to back pain and sciatica).

We'll also go over piriformis syndrome, another cause nerve pain in this area.

Each exercise works a little differently and will be shown in various positions. Make sure to go through them all and use what gives you the most relief.

Watch now and quickly relieve nerve pain in your lower back and leg!

Chapters: 
0:00 Intro
0:39 Bed Exercise 1
4:05 Bed Exercise 2
6:02 Chair Exercise 1
8:19 Chair Exercise 2
10:02 Standing Exercise
